summary: Explicit additive replacement preserving interrupted concurrent-index artifacts

delivery.outcome: Independently publish and apply an exact-database/OID/definition-pinned additive replacement for the known invalid archive index52892 and artifact52899 without modifying either preserved object; resume bounded indexing and verify caller-query readback for issue142.
nonGoals: No DROP, rename, cleanup, data deletion, implicit repair, unknown/healthy/constraint index modification, provider/dependency/release change, or query timeout increase.

architecture.decision: Keep defaults at30s and query deadline5000ms. Explicit digest-pinned plan/apply may request up to120s DDL and a bounded135s batch. Never start an item without its full requested statement budget. Add an explicit replacement-plan/replace that validates exact invalid canonical/artifact OIDs, owners, archive and logical definition; creates one deterministic alternative concurrently and preserves original objects. Ordinary plan accepts that replacement only when exact preserved metadata and valid replacement identity/definition match; ordinary apply/recover never repairs or cleans artifacts.
interfaceChanges: Optional bounded DDL budget plus explicit native replacement-plan/replace operations

dataChanges.description: Additive equivalent physical index, retaining known invalid objects and archive rows. Explicit120s maintenance cap is independent of5000ms query deadline.

architecture.rollback: Protected source revert; known invalid/partial objects are preserved and reported, with no automatic drop or unknown-object change.
